facts.fact: APDP president Luciano Hounkponou says the Autorite de Protection des Donnees a caractere Personnel is an independent authority established by Book V of the Digital Code (Law No. 2017-20 of 20 April 2018, amended 2021) and made up of eight members.
facts.system: Autorite de Protection des Donnees a caractere Personnel (APDP)

systems.system: Autorite de Protection des Donnees a caractere Personnel (APDP)

BEN.note: The president describes the power to sanction but names no decision against an organisation and gives no count.

facts.fact: The APDP president describes the Digital Code (Law No. 2017-20 of 20 April 2018, amended by Law No. 2020-35 of 6 January 2021) as the law under which the authority receives declarations, handles complaints and requires compliance.
The APDP president says the authority has eight members who elect a Bureau of a president and a rapporteur.
facts.system: Autorite de Protection des Donnees a caractere Personnel (APDP)

facts.fact: The APDP president says the authority handles compliance files, trains controllers and data protection delegates yearly since 2021 and takes complaints, without naming a decision on any organisation.

BEN.note: The document mentions only training of local authorities on data protection compliance, not office connections.
The document mentions awareness sessions in schools but gives no internet figure or curriculum fact.
